full_prompt_en: The image is a square natural-light fashion photograph of a young adult man wearing a patterned dashiki against a softly blurred urban background. Behind him, vertical building edges and muted street colours form broad out-of-focus strips, with warmer brick tones on the left and darker grey-green areas on the right. The background provides depth but contains no clearly readable signs or sharply competing objects. In the centre, the man stands upright facing the camera, his shoulders relaxed and his body framed from the top of his head to around the upper thighs. His dark brown skin is evenly rendered, with subdued highlights along the forehead, cheekbones and nose. His hair is cut very short, leaving a clean, rounded outline against the soft background. He has a slight moustache and close facial hair around the chin, and his expression is calm and unsmiling. His eyes look forward, bringing a steady point of contact to a composition otherwise dominated by the garment. Across his shoulders, the loose short-sleeved shirt falls naturally rather than clinging tightly to the body. The base of the fabric is very dark, with narrow repeated motifs in muted turquoise, green, ochre and warm gold. Around the open neckline, a wide decorated border descends vertically over the chest and curves into an elongated ornamental panel. On either side, smaller interlocking lines and leaf-like or geometric marks fill the cloth, changing direction around the central pattern. The repeated marks belong to the textile pattern. Separate fine gold-coloured chains hang over the central chest, including a small dark pendant, their slender loops lying on top of the densely ornamented cloth. Along the left and right sleeves, horizontal bands and tightly spaced patterning define the loose openings above the elbows. At the lower centre, a curved band follows the hanging hem and reinforces the symmetry of the chest decoration. The shirt gathers slightly above dark olive trousers, with the folds softening its otherwise graphic surface. His arms descend close to his sides, and his hands sit partly within the trouser pockets near the lower corners. A dark watch and layered bracelets are visible near the wrists without becoming the focus. The lighting is soft outdoor daylight, brighter from the front-left, giving gentle shape to the face and shallow folds while avoiding harsh cast shadows. The overall composition presents the figure directly and calmly, balancing near-symmetrical textile ornament, subdued street depth and richly coloured fabric within a restrained photographic portrait.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形自然光时装摄影，一位青年男子身穿繁复印花达西基上衣，站在柔焦城市背景前。身后建筑的竖向边缘和街道色彩化为宽阔虚化色带，左边偏暖砖色，右边是较暗的灰绿色。背景提供空间深度，没有清晰可读的标牌或抢眼物件。男子直立于中央，正面面对镜头，肩膀放松，取景从头顶到大腿上部。他的深棕色皮肤表现自然，额头、颧骨和鼻部有柔和亮面。头发剪得很短，在模糊背景前形成整洁的圆润轮廓；上唇与下巴周围有短须，表情平静，没有微笑，眼睛望向前方。短袖宽松上衣顺着肩膀自然垂落，没有紧贴身体。布料底色很深，密集排列着暗青绿、绿色、赭色和暖金色纹样。敞开的领口周围有宽阔装饰边，向下延伸到胸前，并围成细长的中央纹样面板。两侧较小的交错线条、近似叶形与几何形的图案填满衣料，并围绕中央结构改变方向。这些重复细节属于织物图案。另有细金色链饰垂在胸前中央，带着一枚小深色吊坠；细长环线覆在纹样繁密的布面上。左右袖口在肘部上方张开，横向装饰带与细密纹样强调宽松开口。下方中央的弧形纹带沿衣摆延展，呼应胸前近乎对称的装饰。衣服在深橄榄色长裤上方略有堆叠，柔软褶皱缓和了图案的平面感。双臂靠近身体两侧下垂，双手在下方两角部分插入裤袋，腕部可见深色手表和叠戴手链，但并不抢眼。光线为柔和室外日光，左前方稍亮，轻轻塑造面部与浅褶皱，几乎没有生硬投影。整体构图端正安静，在接近对称的织物装饰、低调街道纵深与丰富布料色彩之间保持克制的肖像摄影平衡。
style_prompt_en: The visual language is a direct photographic presentation of richly patterned surfaces against shallow-focus surroundings. Dense nested borders and small repeating organic-geometric marks are organised around a strong central axis, while soft folds interrupt perfect symmetry. Muted turquoise and green contrast with warm ochre and gold over a near-black base. Diffused frontal side light preserves surface colour and subtle volume without glossy theatrical highlights. Fine detail remains concentrated in the main plane, and the surrounding vertical colour bands dissolve smoothly. The overall effect is grounded, tactile and ornamental, with controlled saturation and clear visual hierarchy.
style_prompt_zh: 视觉语言是以浅景深背景衬托丰富纹样的直接摄影表达。密集套叠的边饰与细小重复的有机几何纹样围绕清楚的中轴排列，柔软褶皱打破绝对对称。暗青绿和绿色与暖赭、金色在近黑底色上形成对照。柔和的正侧光保留表面色彩和细微体积，没有戏剧化油亮高光。精细纹理集中在主要焦平面，外围竖向色带平滑虚化。整体质感真实可触，装饰性强，饱和度受到控制，视觉主次清楚。
theme_en: Portrait of a man in a patterned dashiki
theme_zh: 身穿繁复印花达西基上衣的男子肖像
name: Dashiki fashion
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
